hooks.command: if git remote get-url andre >/dev/null 2>&1; then HAS_ANDRE=1; else HAS_ANDRE=0; fi; if [ "$HAS_ANDRE" = 1 ]; then git fetch andre 2>&1; fi; git fetch origin 2>&1; if [ "$HAS_ANDRE" = 1 ]; then AHEAD=$(git rev-list HEAD..andre/main --count 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$AHEAD" -gt 0 ]; then git merge --no-edit andre/main || exit 2; fi; fi; git push origin main || echo "[hook] no se pudo pushear a origin (¿sin credenciales en este entorno?) — los commits quedan locales"; if [ "$HAS_ANDRE" = 1 ]; then git push andre main || exit 2; fi
